    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Minor adaptations in src/node/miner.cpp and src/rpc/mining.cpp to adjust to validation queuing interfaces.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits to mining files mechanically follow changes in validation locking and queueing rather than modifying template construction."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Major modifications to src/net_processing.cpp to decouple block execution from the message processing loop and track downloads under dedicated mutexes.",

      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Decoupling block execution prevents message processing thread stalls that currently block responses to PINGs, compact block requests, and block downloads during heavy validation. This eliminates significant peer latency spikes and liveness hazards under load."
    },

      "name": "rpc",

    },

    },

      "rationale": "Refactoring block processing onto an asynchronous queue substantially reduces cs_main contention and unblocks future work like parallel sibling block validation. Addressing validation bottlenecks on the main thread is strategically important for node throughput."
